gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a significant prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 200.4 million in 2016, representing 36.4% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by a decision to exit the medical malpractice and general liability classes of business, leading to a reserve strengthening for prior years. Specifically, liabilities for the 2007 underwriting year, which included Italian Public Hospitals Medical Malpractice reserves, were strengthened by GBP 5.8 million prior to its closure. The overall loss experience across all years of account was worse than anticipated, necessitating the reserve strengthening.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a material adverse prior-year development in 2016. Gross claims outstanding opened at GBP 551.198m and prior-year incurred claims (gross) during 2016 amounted to GBP 200.399m, representing a c.36.4% adverse movement on opening gross reserves. Management states reserve strengthening was applied across prior years (notably on medical malpractice and general liability exposures) and that loss experience on all years was materially worse than anticipated. The movement was driven by adverse prior-year development across casualty-related lines and certain large/man-made exposures; the 2007 Italian public hospital medical malpractice issue was explicitly strengthened by GBP 5.833m.
